programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: As Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) and Capt. Spock (Leonard Nimoy) monitor trainees at Starfleet Academy, another vessel from the United Federation of Planets is about to try out the planet-creating Genesis Device in a seemingly deserted portion of space. In the process, two of Kirk's officers are captured by Khan (Ricardo Montalban), an enemy Kirk thought he'd never see again. Once more, Kirk takes the Enterprise's helm, where he meets Khan's ship in an intergalactic showdown.

programme.title: No Strings Attached
programme.desc: Lifelong friends Emma (Natalie Portman) and Adam (Ashton Kutcher) take their relationship to the next level by having sex. Afraid of ruining their friendship, the new lovers make a pact to keep things purely physical, with no fighting, no jealousy and no expectations. Emma and Adam pledge to do whatever they want, wherever they want, as long as they do not fall in love. The question then becomes: Who will fall first?

programme.title: Rocketman
programme.desc: Young Reginald Dwight changes his name to Elton John and collaborates with singer-songwriter Bernie Taupin to become one of the most iconic figures in pop history. Set to his most beloved songs, it's the epic musical story of Elton John, his breakthrough years in the 1970s and his fantastical transformation from shy piano prodigy to international superstar.

programme.title: Love and Monsters
programme.desc: Seven years after the Monsterpocalypse, Joel Dawson, along with the rest of humanity, has been living underground ever since giant creatures took control of the land. After reconnecting over the radio with his high school girlfriend, Aimee, who is now 80 miles away at a coastal colony, Joel begins to fall for her again. As Joel realizes that there's nothing left for him underground, he decides to venture out to Aimee, despite all the dangerous monsters that stand in his way.

programme.title: Everybody Wants Some!!
programme.desc: In 1980 Texas, a college freshman (Blake Jenner) meets his new baseball teammates (Will Brittain, Ryan Guzman), an unruly group of disco-dancing, skirt-chasing partyers.

programme.title: No Strings Attached
programme.desc: Lifelong friends Emma (Natalie Portman) and Adam (Ashton Kutcher) take their relationship to the next level by having sex. Afraid of ruining their friendship, the new lovers make a pact to keep things purely physical, with no fighting, no jealousy and no expectations. Emma and Adam pledge to do whatever they want, wherever they want, as long as they do not fall in love. The question then becomes: Who will fall first?

programme.title: The Other Guys
programme.desc: Unlike their heroic counterparts on the force, desk-bound NYPD detectives Gamble and Hoitz garner no headlines as they work day to day. Gamble relishes his job as a paper pusher, but Hoitz is itching to get back on the street and make a name for himself. When a seemingly minor case turns out to be a big deal, the two cops get the opportunity to finally prove to their comrades that they have the right stuff.

programme.title: Jackass 3
programme.desc: Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O, Wee Man and the rest of their fearless and foolhardy friends take part in another round of outrageous pranks and stunts. In addition to standing in the path of a charging bull, launching themselves into the air and crashing through various objects, the guys perform in segments such as "Sweatsuit Cocktail," "Beehive Tetherball" and "Lamborghini Tooth Pull."

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa
programme.desc: Irascible Irving Zisman (Johnny Knoxville) and his young and impressionable grandson, Billy (Jackson Nicoll), set out on a road trip across America. Hidden cameras capture their insane and shocking encounters with a diverse set of unsuspecting citizens, including male strippers, disgruntled contestants (and their mothers) from a children's beauty pageant, mourners at a funeral home, patrons at a biker bar and more. Based on the "Jackass" TV series.

programme.title: Twisted
programme.desc: Recently promoted and transferred to the homicide division, Inspector Jessica Shepard (Ashley Judd) feels pressure to prove herself -- and what better way than by solving San Francisco's latest murder? However, as Shepard and her partner, Mike Delmarco (Andy Garcia), soon discover, the victim shared a romantic connection to her. As more of Shepard's ex-lovers turn up dead, her mind starts to become unstable, and she begins to wonder if she could be the very killer she's trying to track down.

programme.title: Deadlock
programme.desc: Wanted criminal Ron Whitlock leads a rogue team of mercenaries on a mission of vengeance. Convinced that the government is working against them, the merciless group brutally seizes an energy plant and holds everyone inside hostage. With a nearby town on the brink of massive flooding and destruction, it's up to a retired Army ranger to save thousands of innocent lives before it's too late.

programme.title: Rocketman
programme.desc: Young Reginald Dwight changes his name to Elton John and collaborates with singer-songwriter Bernie Taupin to become one of the most iconic figures in pop history. Set to his most beloved songs, it's the epic musical story of Elton John, his breakthrough years in the 1970s and his fantastical transformation from shy piano prodigy to international superstar.

programme.title: Crisis
programme.desc: A drug trafficker organizes a smuggling operation while a recovering addict seeks the truth behind her son's disappearance.

programme.title: Barron's Cove
programme.desc: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps.

programme.title: 48 HRS.
programme.desc: Renegade cop Jack Cates (Nick Nolte) pulls bank robber Reggie Hammond (Eddie Murphy) from a federal prison on a 48-hour leave to help him capture Hammond's old partner, Albert Ganz (James Remar). Having escaped from a prison work crew, Ganz is on a killing spree around San Francisco, on the trail of half a million dollars that went missing after one of his robberies. The cocky Reggie knows where the money is, but spars with the hotheaded Jack as he enjoys his temporary freedom.

programme.title: Guns Up
programme.desc: After a job goes horribly wrong, a man who moonlights as a mob henchman has one night to get his family out of the city while keeping his dark secret hidden.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: Brad Pitt stars as Jerry Welbach, a reluctant bagman, who has been given two ultimatums: The first is from his mob boss to travel to Mexico and retrieve a priceless antique pistol, known as "the Mexican"... or suffer the consequences. The second is from his girlfriend Samantha (Julia Roberts) to end his association with the mob. Jerry figures alive and in trouble with Samantha is better than the more permanent alternative, so he heads south of the border.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss (Josh Brolin) finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh (Javier Bardem) picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss.

programme.title: Crisis
programme.desc: A drug trafficker organizes a smuggling operation while a recovering addict seeks the truth behind her son's disappearance.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: It's the height of the Cold War, and famous archaeologist Indiana Jones (Harrison Ford), returning from his latest adventure, finds out his job at Marshall College is in jeopardy. He meets Mutt (Shia La Beouf), a young man who wants Indy to help him find the legendary Crystal Skull of Akator, and the pair set out for Peru. However, deadly agent Irina Spalko (Cate Blanchett) is searching for the powerful artifact, too, because the Soviets believe it can help them conquer the world.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: Thrilled by his experience with the Avengers, young Peter Parker returns home to live with his Aunt May. Under the watchful eye of mentor Tony Stark, Parker starts to embrace his newfound identity as Spider-Man. He also tries to return to his normal daily routine -- distracted by thoughts of proving himself to be more than just a friendly neighborhood superhero. Peter must soon put his powers to the test when the evil Vulture emerges to threaten everything that he holds dear.

programme.title: Coldwater
programme.desc: After failing to intervene in a violent incident at a London playgroun, John moves his family to the rural Scottish Idyll of Coldwater, where their new neighbors harbor a dangerous secret.

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

programme.title: The Comeback Trail
programme.desc: Indebted to a mobster, a desperate producer tries to "accidentally" kill an aging movie star for an insurance scam. However, he soon begins to realize that the film they're shooting is a masterpiece in the making.

programme.title: Hard Eight
programme.desc: A stranger (Philip Baker Hall) mentors a young Reno gambler (John C. Reilly) who weds a hooker (Gwyneth Paltrow) and befriends a vulgar casino regular.

programme.title: Wander
programme.desc: Hired to investigate a suspicious death in the town of Wander, a paranoid private eye with a troubled past becomes convinced the case is linked to the same conspiracy and cover-up that caused the death of his daughter.

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: When hotheaded Superboy (Michael Rapaport) accidentally gets involved in an ugly racially-motivated incident, his uncle Ray Donlan (Harvey Keitel), a corrupt New York City cop, attempts to sweep it under the rug by helping fake his nephew's death. The bungled cover-up leads to investigations by idealistic Internal Affairs officer Moe Tilden (Robert De Niro) and Freddy Heflin (Sylvester Stallone), sheriff of the suburban New Jersey town where Donlan and his fellow crooked policemen live.

programme.title: Marvin's Room
programme.desc: Bessie (Diane Keaton) and Lee (Meryl Streep) are sisters who have remained apart for nearly 20 years due to radically different personalities and life paths. Bessie remained in Florida to care for their ill, bed-ridden father (Hume Cronyn), and Lee moved to Ohio to marry and have a family. But Bessie's doctor (Robert De Niro) has informed her she has leukemia and needs a bone marrow transplant. Bessie's prognosis and Lee's troubled son (Leonardo DiCaprio) create an unexpected family reunion.

programme.title: Love Me
programme.desc: A buoy and a satellite meet online long after humanity's extinction. As they learn what life was like on Earth, they discover themselves and what it means to be alive and in love.

programme.title: Extract
programme.desc: The owner of a factory that produces flavor extracts, Joel Reynold (Jason Bateman) seems to have it all, but really doesn't. What's missing is sexual attention from his wife, Suzie (Kristen Wiig). Joel hatches a convoluted plan to get Suzie to cheat on him, thereby clearing the way for Joel to have an affair with Cindy (Mila Kunis), an employee. But what Joel doesn't know is that Cindy is a sociopathic con artist, and a freak workplace accident clears the way for her to ruin Joel forever.

programme.title: The Girl in the Pool
programme.desc: A man's life collapses when his mistress is found dead in his pool. Terrified of the consequences and desperate to protect his family, he conceals the truth, triggering a chaotic night that threatens to unravel his perfect life.

programme.title: Scream 4
programme.desc: It has been many years since the Ghostface Killer cut a deadly path through the town of Woodsboro. In order to get over the trauma of those horrific events, Sidney Prescott (Neve Campbell) has written a self-help book. She returns to Woodsboro for her book tour, and reconnects with old friends Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) and Sheriff Dewey (David Arquette). However, Sidney's arrival also sparks the return of Ghostface, putting Sidney and everyone she loves in danger.

programme.title: 40 Days and 40 Nights
programme.desc: Matt Sullivan's (Josh Hartnett) last big relationship ended in disaster and ever since his heart's been aching and his commitment's been lacking. Then came Lent, that time of year when everybody gives something up. That's when Matt decides to go where no man's gone before and make a vow: No sex. Whatsoever. For 40 straight days. At first he has everything under control. That is until the woman of his dreams, Erica (Shannyn Sossamon), walks into his life.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody...

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: Sydney (Neve Campbell) and tabloid reporter Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) survived the events of the first Scream, but their nightmare isn't over. When two college students are murdered at a sneak preview of Stab, a movie based on the events from the first film, it's clear a copycat killer is on the loose. Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead.

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: In the final installment to this trilogy, a murdering spree begins to happen again; this time targeted toward the original Woodsboro survivors and those associated with the movie-inside a-movie, Stab 3. Sydney (Neve Campbell) must face the demons of her past to stop the killer(s).

programme.desc: A year after narrowly escaping death at the hands of Michael Myers (Tyler Mane), Laurie Strode is at the breaking point, pushed to the edge by Dr. Loomis' (Malcolm McDowell) revelation that she's Michael's sister. Little does she know, the unstoppable killer is back in Haddonfield and, driven by visions of their dead mother (Sheri Moon Zombie), he is determined to bring about a bloody family reunion.

Hidden cameras capture their insane and shocking encounters with a diverse set of unsuspecting citizens, including male strippers, disgruntled contestants (and their mothers) from a children's beauty pageant, mourners at a funeral home, patrons at a biker bar and more. Based on the "Jackass" TV series.

programme.title: Twisted
programme.desc: Recently promoted and transferred to the homicide division, Inspector Jessica Shepard (Ashley Judd) feels pressure to prove herself -- and what better way than by solving San Francisco's latest murder? However, as Shepard and her partner, Mike Delmarco (Andy Garcia), soon discover, the victim shared a romantic connection to her. As more of Shepard's ex-lovers turn up dead, her mind starts to become unstable, and she begins to wonder if she could be the very killer she's trying to track down.

programme.title: Deadlock
programme.desc: Wanted criminal Ron Whitlock leads a rogue team of mercenaries on a mission of vengeance. Convinced that the government is working against them, the merciless group brutally seizes an energy plant and holds everyone inside hostage. With a nearby town on the brink of massive flooding and destruction, it's up to a retired Army ranger to save thousands of innocent lives before it's too late.

programme.title: Rocketman
programme.desc: Young Reginald Dwight changes his name to Elton John and collaborates with singer-songwriter Bernie Taupin to become one of the most iconic figures in pop history. Set to his most beloved songs, it's the epic musical story of Elton John, his breakthrough years in the 1970s and his fantastical transformation from shy piano prodigy to international superstar.

programme.title: Crisis
programme.desc: A drug trafficker organizes a smuggling operation while a recovering addict seeks the truth behind her son's disappearance.

programme.title: Barron's Cove
programme.desc: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps.

programme.title: 48 HRS.
programme.desc: Renegade cop Jack Cates (Nick Nolte) pulls bank robber Reggie Hammond (Eddie Murphy) from a federal prison on a 48-hour leave to help him capture Hammond's old partner, Albert Ganz (James Remar). Having escaped from a prison work crew, Ganz is on a killing spree around San Francisco, on the trail of half a million dollars that went missing after one of his robberies. The cocky Reggie knows where the money is, but spars with the hotheaded Jack as he enjoys his temporary freedom.

programme.title: Guns Up
programme.desc: After a job goes horribly wrong, a man who moonlights as a mob henchman has one night to get his family out of the city while keeping his dark secret hidden.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: Brad Pitt stars as Jerry Welbach, a reluctant bagman, who has been given two ultimatums: The first is from his mob boss to travel to Mexico and retrieve a priceless antique pistol, known as "the Mexican"... or suffer the consequences. The second is from his girlfriend Samantha (Julia Roberts) to end his association with the mob. Jerry figures alive and in trouble with Samantha is better than the more permanent alternative, so he heads south of the border.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss (Josh Brolin) finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh (Javier Bardem) picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss.

programme.title: 24UR
programme.desc:
24UR je na programu vsak dan ob 18:55.
Z dinamičnim pristopom, voditeljskimi pari, novimi idejami in atraktivno podobo, ki omogoča vsebinsko bogato podajo novic, je dnevno najbolj gledana osrednja dnevnoinformativna oddaja v Sloveniji. Poleg rednih rubrik najaktualnejše novice dneva zajemajo tudi vremensko napoved, družabno kroniko in šport.
Voditelji: Jani Muhič in Petra Kerčmar, Edi Pucer in Darja Zgonc.

programme.title: Pavza!: Pop kolach
programme.desc:
Prepustite se glasbi!
Videospoti popularnih izvajalcev, povezani v najboljši miks za odmor, zabavo in počitek, za sprostitev možgančkov, za vzdušje, za ples, da se napolni srce! Za vas smo pripravili Pavzo!

programme.title: Ko cvetijo češnje
programme.desc:
Oyku in Ayaz v Rimu preživita nekaj romantičnih dni. Ko se vrneta domov, pa ju čakajo presenečenja. Sibel in Ilker bi se rada ločila, zato ju pokličeta za priči. Prijatelja ju razočarata, ker pred sodnico ne navedeta nobenega razloga za ločitev. Tudi Ayazova starša se hudo skregata. Onem odpusti Oyku, ki je za dva meseca odpotovala v Italijo, noče pa, da ostane z njenim sinom.
Oyku bi rada uspela kot modna oblikovalka, Ayaz pa je uspešen arhitekt. Sprva si gresta na živce, saj je Oyku všeč njegov sodelavec Mete, ki pa je všeč tudi njeni prijateljici Seymi. Filiz Gülmez Pakman, Tarkan Karlidag, Eda Teksöz Nilperi Sahinkaya Özge Gürel Nihal Isiksaçan Aras Aydin Fatma Toptas.

programme.title: Ko cvetijo češnje
programme.desc:
Onem izve, da je umrl predsednik uprave podjetja, ki ga želi kupiti. Ker si močno želi, da bi Atlantist postal njen, se s partnerji takoj odpravi na sedež, da bi v prodajo prepričali novega lastnika. Oyku medtem prejme klic neznanca. Izkaže se, da ji je Nazim zapustil svojo modno hišo Atlantist. Nihče ne verjame, da bo kos vodenju velikega podjetja, ona pa želi uspeti
Oyku bi rada uspela kot modna oblikovalka, Ayaz pa je uspešen arhitekt. Sprva si gresta na živce, saj je Oyku všeč njegov sodelavec Mete, ki pa je všeč tudi njeni prijateljici Seymi. Filiz Gülmez Pakman, Tarkan Karlidag, Eda Teksöz Nilperi Sahinkaya Özge Gürel Nihal Isiksaçan Aras Aydin Fatma Toptas.

programme.title: 24UR zvečer
programme.desc:
Informativna oddaja 24UR zvečer je na programu vsak delovnik od ponedeljka do petka.
Oddaja vsebinsko nadgrajuje osrednjih 24UR. V njej so na atraktiven način podane najpomembnejše novice in zgodbe dneva, obogatene s pregledom zadnjih, najnovejših večernih domačih in tujih dogodkov.
24UR zvečer ponuja vsebinsko, vizualno bogat in sodoben vpogled v dogajanje dneva.

programme.title: 24UR Inšpektor: Kdo (sploh) še smuča?
programme.desc:
Pred zimskimi počitnicami. Koliko stanejo vsako leto dražje smučarske karte, šola smučanja, smučarska oprema, pa tudi gostinska ponudba? Kaj dobimo na večjih avstrijskih in italijanskih smučiščih?
24UR Inšpektor je rubrika, obarvana potrošniško, uporabniško.
V njen skupaj s strokovnjaki analizirajo teme, izdelke testirajo in preizkušajo v laboratorijih. Opozarjajo na napake, zavajanja in nepravilnosti posnamejo s skrito kamero. Z relevantnimi strokovnjaki dajejo nasvete in povedo, kaj je prav in kaj ne, z enim samim ciljem - ozavestiti potrošnike. Pred zimskimi počitnicami. Koliko stanejo vsako leto dražje smučarske karte, šola smučanja, smučarska oprema, pa tudi gostinska ponudba? Kaj dobimo na večjih avstrijskih in italijanskih smučiščih?

programme.title: Gorski zdravnik
programme.desc:
Gorski zdravnik se na vso moč trudi pomagati bratoma Vinzentu in Lennartu, ki sta ostala brez očeta. Zakaj Vinzent doživlja panične napade?nnVendar Martina ne skrbi le zdravstveno stanje njegovega mladega pacienta, temveč tudi njegove matere Lisbeth. Še vedno se ni umirilo tresenje njene desne roke. Medtem banka povečuje pritisk na Pflügerjeve, Lillijinemu dedku Rolfu pa grozi obtožba zaradi goljufije.
Serija predstavlja pustolovščine zdravnika in gorskega reševalca v idiličnih krajih avstrijskih Alp.
Martin Gruber živi svoje življenje skupaj z družino in se ukvarja s tistim, kar ljubi, in vse to v idilični pokrajini med gorami. Vsak primer, ki ga rešuje, pa je tesno povezan z družino in prijatelji. Alexander Sascha Thiel Hans Sigl Heiko Ruprecht Monika Baumgartner Mark Keller Ronja Forcher Natalie O'Hara Rebecca Immanuel Annika Ernst Wolfram Berger Frédéric Brossier Tom Böttcher Hilde Dalik Vanessa Velemir Diaz Hannah Gharib Jonas Kaufmann Barbara Lanz Beat Marti Dominic Raacke Luis

programme.title: Vaše zdravje, naša skrb
programme.desc:
Oddaja, namenjena izključno vašemu zdravju, v kateri se bomo posvetili zdravstvenim tegobam današnjega časa in vam ponudili rešitve za boljši jutri.
Hiter tempo življenja, slaba kvaliteta hrane, stres in genska zasnova – vse to vpliva na naše življenje bolj, kot bi si mislili. Po 40. letu starosti pa se začnejo počasi kazati posledice na našem telesu.
Slabo počutje, težave s prebavo, težave s sklepi, bolezni srca in ožilja, težave s sečili (ledvice, prostata), slaba koncentracija in slabši spomin; vse to in še mnogo več težav, s katerimi se borimo. Mi vam lahko pomagamo in svetujemo, kako lahko izboljšate svoj jutri.
Strokovnjaki iz slovenskega družinskega podjetja Biovis vam bomo v vsaki oddaji svetovali in vas informirali o različnih zdravstvenih težavah, s katerimi se spopadate, ter vam pomagali k boljšemu počutju.
Strokovnjaki, ki se z različnimi zdravstvenimi problemi ukvarjamo že skoraj 20 let, točno vemo, katero prehransko dopolnilo vam bo pri vaši težavi prišlo prav.
Pa ne

programme.title: Reka ljubezni
programme.desc:
Bojan se izpove Sonji in ji končno prizna celotno situacijo glede Erika. Valentina obišče Terezo. Irena od Roka dobi žalostno sporočilo, Jan pa je jezen na Erika. Zala nehote najde karte za križarjenje. Ali bodo Medvedovi odpotovali na družinski dopust?
Reka ljubezni je nova, originalna slovenska serija, ki nas bo ponesla v idilični svet ob Krki.
Osrednja lika serije sta Irena Rot in Rok Slak, prikupna fotografinja iz mesta in simpatičen mizar z Dolenjske. Njuna pot do sreče pa bo vse prej kot lahka. V na prvi pogled idilični vasi se začnejo dogajati sumljive stvari, nekdo namreč podtika požare in seje strah v kosti vaščanom in gasilcem. Videti je, da nekateri komaj čakajo, da stegnejo svoje kremplje okrog vratu romantičnih parov, a prav ogenj zaneti prve iskre ljubezni. Da ne prehitevamo, Irena in Rok se morata najprej spoznati. Nejc Levstik, Jaka Šuligoj Lara Komar Tadej Pišek Marijana Brecelj Voranc Boh Mojca Funkl Branko Šturbej Nina Ivanič Renato Jenček Blaž Valič Gregor Gruden.

programme.title: TV prodaja
programme.desc: Program TV prodaje.

programme.title: Botri
programme.desc:
Andjela vztraja, da Martin odpelje Lenko na avtobusno postajo z Zvonetovim avtom. Tako Aljoša in Vinko kot tudi Stipan skušajo Matijo zvleči na svojo stran. Na koncu ji najbolj pomaga pogovor z Ivko, s katero se strinjata, da vsi trije pretiravajo in da družina trpi zaradi njihovih škandalov.nnMilica organizira prihod svetovno znane kiparke hrvaških korenin Tereze Bujić v Zaglave. Luce razmišlja o Janku in mu pošilja sporočila, a jih on ne vidi, ker je preveč zaposlen.
V tretji sezoni bodo Zaglave doživele popoln pretres z novimi dogodki in zanimivimi preobrati.
Znane obraze iz serije čakajo strašni zapleti in blazne spletke. Pridružili se jim bodo novi liki, ki bodo seriji dali nove razsežnosti, novo dinamiko in novo zgodbo. Mesto Zaglave bo doživelo nepričakovan preobrat in ubralo popolnoma novo smer razvoja. Turistično. Če si lahko zamislite kaj takega.
Ideja je zrasla na kanadskem zelniku bogatega izseljenca Stanislava Stanleyja Cukela, ki se je odločil vrniti in vnesti duh svet

programme.title: V dobrem in slabem
programme.desc:
Joco in Veljko izvesta, da bosta postala dedka, medtem ko Damjan raziskuje prevaro. Ivana in Marina začasno zakopljeta bojno sekiro, Zrinko pa skrbi, ker zaradi Veljkovega škandala izgublja učence. Crni ne miruje in skuša izvedeti, kdo je lastnik groba. Joco je šokiran, ko mu Una razkrije, da ne ve, kdo je oče njenega otroka.
Hrvaška serija V dobrem in slabem spremlja Veljka Srića, človeka, ki ga imajo vsi radi.
Veljko je uspešen podjetnik, ljubljeni mož in oče treh otrok. ki živi sanjsko življenje. Vendar se za to na videz popolno fasado skriva šokantna skrivnost - vzporedno življenje in druga družina v Sarajevu.
Veljko skrivnost skriva že 25 let, a ko izve, da sta mu ostala le še dva meseca življenja, se odloči soočiti z resnico in združiti obe družini pod eno streho. Njegovo priznanje bo sprožilo plaz čustev, konfliktov in nepredvidljivih dogodkov. Darko Drinovac, Tomislav Rukavina, Ivan Šarić, Josip Žuvan Katarina Baban Ana Begić Ivona Dragas Bilogrevic Filip Budimir Amar Bukvić

programme.title: Gorski zdravnik
programme.desc:
Šivilja Jasmin pride v ordinacijo Martina Gruberja s srbečimi rokami. Čeprav so simptomi prisotni že več mesecev in je že obiskala zdravnika, še vedno ni prejela diagnoze.nnMlada pacientka Martinu zaupa, da želi čim prej oditi iz Ellmaua in stran od mame Silke, ki vso pozornost preusmerja nase, nenehno sprejema odločitve namesto nje ter Jasmininih načrtov za odhod ne jemlje resno. Bo Martin uspel zgladiti njun odnos?
Serija predstavlja pustolovščine zdravnika in gorskega reševalca v idiličnih krajih avstrijskih Alp.
Martin Gruber živi svoje življenje skupaj z družino in se ukvarja s tistim, kar ljubi, in vse to v idilični pokrajini med gorami. Vsak primer, ki ga rešuje, pa je tesno povezan z družino in prijatelji. programme.title: Skrito v raju
programme.desc:
Julija pove Bojanu, da so očetu ponudili mesto ministra. Bojan dobi idejo, pri kom mora lobirati, da bi sam postal minister. Sanji ne gre iz glave Pečnikov obisk, zato ga preveri. K Juliji pride policija, ker so izsledili signal Stanetovega telefona, medtem ko Pečnik operativcu naroči, naj v Edijevem stanovanju najde Stanetov telefon. Saška je zaskrbljena zaradi staršev.
Slovenska serija Skrito v raju nas popelje v istrski kamp Paradiso, kjer si pisana bera dopustnikov polni baterije od vrveža glavnega mesta.
Glavna junaka sta Lara in Mark, ki se zaljubita na prvi pogled, a je pred njima še vrsta zapletov, ki so resen izziv za njuno zvezo. Rahela Jagrič Pirc Aleksandra Balmazović Aleš Valič Blaž Valič Gaber Trseglav Gaja Filač Matej Zemljič Mila Peršin Sabina Kogovšek Tanja Potočnik Vesna Pernarčič Zala Đurić Ribič Sandra Debelak Matino Antunović Mei Rabič Alen Šalinović Matic Valič Primož Vrhovec Melanie Mekicar Valter Dragan Vesna Ponorac.

programme.title: Zlati sanjski moški: Avstralija
programme.desc:
Bearu je ostalo le še sedem žensk in čustveni vrtinci so na vrhuncu. Bear odpelje Kim v športnem avtu, ji pokaže družinsko dediščino in znova se zaneti iskrica, zato si Kim brez težav prisluži vrtnico. Dame dobijo čustvena sporočila od doma, kar ganljivo vpliva na vse. Katera od njih bo na podelitvi vrtnic zavrnjena tokrat?
61-letni vdovec Barry Bear Myrden je pripravljen na novo priložnost. Spozna 20 izjemnih žensk, ki v zrelih letih iščejo ljubezen.
Upravljalka dvigal, radijska voditeljica, medicinska sestra - nabor je res pester!
Na koktajl zabavi Sunny ukrade Beara, a jo prekine vsiljivka Kim. Bianca razkrije svoj strah pred zavrnitvijo, Jan pa prejme "vrtnico prvega vtisa".

programme.title: Večerja za 5
programme.desc:
Večerja za 5 je priljubljena hrvaška kulinarična oddaja, ki prinaša različne recepte iz loncev domače kuhinje.
Tekmovalci pogosto pripravijo zanimive specialitete, s katerimi razveselijo brbončice sotekmovalcev. Večerja je sestavljena iz predjedi, glavne jedi in sladice. Na koncu večera gostje komentirajo pogostitev in vzdušje ter podajo oceno gostitelju.

programme.title: Po poti resnice
programme.desc:
Erdal tožilki Iclal pove, da Cinar ni vedel, za kaj gre, ko mu je predal zdravilo. Tugce s Firatom preiskuje primer odsekane glave. Ceylin skrbi, kako Elif doživlja razhod staršev, hkrati pa preiskuje primer obolelih učencev istega razreda. Ekipa pri Cihanu pod hladilnikom najde okrvavljen nož. Parla izve, da je gospod Canberk, ena od njenih strank, varal ženo.
Ilgaz je javni tožilec, ki je od svojega očeta prejel visoka etična načela glede poštenosti, časti in spoštovanja.
Ceylin je uspešna odvetnica, ki je morala zgodaj odrasti, ker so njenega očeta obsodili po krivem. Prav zaradi tega se je v svojem poklicu naučila ubirati tudi stranske poti.
Ko nekoč hoče od Ilgaza na nezakonit način pridobiti informacije, seveda dobi lekcijo o etiki in morali.
Ko pa Ilgazovega brata Cinarja obtožijo umora, je Ilgaz prvič prisiljen kršiti pravila. Obrne se prav na Ceylin, da bi zastopala njegovega brata. Ali Bilgin Kaan Urgancioglu Pinar Deniz Zeyno Eracar Ugur Aslan Arda Aranat Pinar Caglar Ge

programme.title: 24UR popoldne
programme.desc:
24UR popoldne je na programu vsak dan ob 16.55 in poteka v živo iz osrednjega studia POP TV.
Oddaja na kratek, zgoščen in dinamičen način ponuja do takrat najaktualnejše novice dneva z različnih področij življenja: politike, gospodarstva, kronike, športa in vremensko napoved. Voditelji: Petra Kerčmar, Jani Muhič, Darja Zgonc in Edi Pucer.

programme.desc:
Crni na pokopališču sreča žensko, zaradi katere pride do šokantnega spoznanja. Lorena obupuje zaradi Jakova in razmišlja o odhodu iz mesta, preden kdo opazi nosečnost. Petra se sprička z ljubosumnim Crnim in obišče Loreno, ki ji predlaga skupen pobeg. Miro pa se zaupa materi glede Unine nosečnosti.

programme.title: 24UR vreme
programme.desc:
24UR vreme je z vami vsak dan pred osrednjo informativno oddajo.

programme.title: Ko cvetijo češnje
programme.desc:
Oyku uniči Ayazovo dragoceno podpisano majico. Seyma se spre z Onem, ker noče vohuniti za Oyku. Burcu Meteja prosi, naj zaposli Emreja, a Emre ponudbo zavrne. Ilker in Emre načrtujeta ustanovitev svojega podjetja. Ayaz in Mete za Onem skleneta posel. Oyku ima kot lastnica težave z vodenjem podjetja, Seyma pa hoče ponovno osvojiti Meteja.
Oyku bi rada uspela kot modna oblikovalka, Ayaz pa je uspešen arhitekt. Sprva si gresta na živce, saj je Oyku všeč njegov sodelavec Mete, ki pa je všeč tudi njeni prijateljici Seymi. programme.title: Ko cvetijo češnje
programme.desc:

Emre in Ilker odpreta restavracijo na kolesih in jo postavita pred Sibelino restavracijo. Mete spozna Naz in gre z njo na večerjo.

programme.title: Gorski zdravnik
programme.desc:
Šivilja Jasmin pride v ordinacijo Martina Gruberja s srbečimi rokami. Čeprav so simptomi prisotni že več mesecev in je že obiskala zdravnika, še vedno ni prejela diagnoze.nnMlada pacientka Martinu zaupa, da želi čim prej oditi iz Ellmaua in stran od mame Silke, ki vso pozornost preusmerja nase, nenehno sprejema odločitve namesto nje ter Jasmininih načrtov za odhod ne jemlje resno. Bo Martin uspel zgladiti njun odnos?
Serija predstavlja pustolovščine zdravnika in gorskega reševalca v idiličnih krajih avstrijskih Alp.
Martin Gruber živi svoje življenje skupaj z družino in se ukvarja s tistim, kar ljubi, in vse to v idilični pokrajini med gorami. Vsak primer, ki ga rešuje, pa je tesno povezan z družino in prijatelji. programme.title: Vaše zdravje, naša skrb
programme.desc:
Oddaja, namenjena izključno vašemu zdravju, v kateri se bomo posvetili zdravstvenim tegobam današnjega časa in vam ponudili rešitve za boljši jutri.
Hiter tempo življenja, slaba kvaliteta hrane, stres in genska zasnova – vse to vpliva na naše življenje bolj, kot bi si mislili. Po 40. letu starosti pa se začnejo počasi kazati posledice na našem telesu.
Slabo počutje, težave s prebavo, težave s sklepi, bolezni srca in ožilja, težave s sečili (ledvice, prostata), slaba koncentracija in slabši spomin; vse to in še mnogo več težav, s katerimi se borimo. Mi vam lahko pomagamo in svetujemo, kako lahko izboljšate svoj jutri.
Strokovnjaki iz slovenskega družinskega podjetja Biovis vam bomo v vsaki oddaji svetovali in vas informirali o različnih zdravstvenih težavah, s katerimi se spopadate, ter vam pomagali k boljšemu počutju.
Strokovnjaki, ki se z različnimi zdravstvenimi problemi ukvarjamo že skoraj 20 let, točno vemo, katero prehransko dopolnilo vam bo pri vaši težavi prišlo prav.
Pa ne

programme.title: Reka ljubezni
programme.desc:
Gašper in Petra se dogovorita, da bosta šla skupaj na plavanje. Sonja pokliče Erika, Mojca pa ureja stojnico za Rokove in Blaževe ptičke.nnVida izve, kaj se je zgodilo z Janezom. Bojan ugotovi, da je Sonja klicala Erika. Valentina se sooči z Andrejem glede predkupne pravice. Zala sprašuje, kje je Sonja. Rok pove Mariji, da bo zaprl delavnico.
Reka ljubezni je nova, originalna slovenska serija, ki nas bo ponesla v idilični svet ob Krki.
Osrednja lika serije sta Irena Rot in Rok Slak, prikupna fotografinja iz mesta in simpatičen mizar z Dolenjske. Njuna pot do sreče pa bo vse prej kot lahka. V na prvi pogled idilični vasi se začnejo dogajati sumljive stvari, nekdo namreč podtika požare in seje strah v kosti vaščanom in gasilcem. Videti je, da nekateri komaj čakajo, da stegnejo svoje kremplje okrog vratu romantičnih parov, a prav ogenj zaneti prve iskre ljubezni. Da ne prehitevamo, Irena in Rok se morata najprej spoznati. Nejc Levstik, Jaka Šuligoj Lara Komar Tadej Pišek Marijana Brecel

programme.title: V dobrem in slabem
programme.desc:
Crni na pokopališču sreča žensko, zaradi katere pride do šokantnega spoznanja. Lorena obupuje zaradi Jakova in razmišlja o odhodu iz mesta, preden kdo opazi nosečnost. Petra se sprička z ljubosumnim Crnim in obišče Loreno, ki ji predlaga skupen pobeg. Miro pa se zaupa materi glede Unine nosečnosti.
Hrvaška serija V dobrem in slabem spremlja Veljka Srića, človeka, ki ga imajo vsi radi.
Veljko je uspešen podjetnik, ljubljeni mož in oče treh otrok. ki živi sanjsko življenje. Vendar se za to na videz popolno fasado skriva šokantna skrivnost - vzporedno življenje in druga družina v Sarajevu.
Veljko skrivnost skriva že 25 let, a ko izve, da sta mu ostala le še dva meseca življenja, se odloči soočiti z resnico in združiti obe družini pod eno streho. Njegovo priznanje bo sprožilo plaz čustev, konfliktov in nepredvidljivih dogodkov. programme.title: Skrito v raju
programme.desc:
Nina rine Laro vedno globlje v laži, Larino stisko pa poglobi še Mia s podrobnimi vprašanji. David se poskuša izvleči iz neprijetne situacije, da je telefon našel na dvorišču. Bojan obišče Sanjo in ji natvezi zgodbo, kako je Edi izkoristil Stanetovo krhko zdravje, da bi postal minister. Ko operativec vdre v Edijevo stanovanje, se Edi znajde na napačnem mestu ob napačnem času.
Slovenska serija Skrito v raju nas popelje v istrski kamp Paradiso, kjer si pisana bera dopustnikov polni baterije od vrveža glavnega mesta.
Glavna junaka sta Lara in Mark, ki se zaljubita na prvi pogled, a je pred njima še vrsta zapletov, ki so resen izziv za njuno zvezo. Tekmovalci pogosto pripravijo zanimive specialitete, s katerimi razveselijo brbončice sotekmovalcev. Večerja je sestavljena iz predjedi, glavne jedi in sladice. Na koncu večera gostje komentirajo pogostitev in vzdušje ter podajo oceno gostitelju.

programme.title: Po poti resnice
programme.desc:
Tugce na terenu išče brata gospe Duru. Ko stoji pred njegovim slikarskim studiem, sliši, da se v bloku nekaj dogaja. Trije moški hočejo posiliti prostitutko, zato Tugce sproži opozorilni strel in jih postroji ob steno. Tam je še četrti moški, ki jo z udarcem po glavi onesvesti. Tožilka Iclal Yekto obtoži uničevanja dokazov in korupcije ter ga prijavi odvetniški zbornici.
Ilgaz je javni tožilec, ki je od svojega očeta prejel visoka etična načela glede poštenosti, časti in spoštovanja.
Ceylin je uspešna odvetnica, ki je morala zgodaj odrasti, ker so njenega očeta obsodili po krivem. Prav zaradi tega se je v svojem poklicu naučila ubirati tudi stranske poti.
Ko nekoč hoče od Ilgaza na nezakonit način pridobiti informacije, seveda dobi lekcijo o etiki in morali.
Ko pa Ilgazovega brata Cinarja obtožijo umora, je Ilgaz prvič prisiljen kršiti pravila. Obrne se prav na Ceylin, da bi zastopala njegovega brata. Ali Bilgin Kaan Urgancioglu Pinar Deniz Zeyno Eracar Ugur Aslan Arda Aranat Pinar

Klaudija in Damjan preiskujeta Zdravkovo izginotje in na kraju nesreče najdeta Gabrijeline dokumente. Toma Niki prizna, da je pretepel policista.

programme.title: Botri
programme.desc:
Milica in Marko sta končno mož in žena, a poročna zabava je na njiju pustila boleče posledice: Marko si je porezal roko, Milica pa zvila nogo.nnHrvojki in Mirjani postane jasno, da se med Bracom in Vedrano nekaj plete, zato se Hrvojka odloči za drastični ukrep. Matija odhaja v Basel, Milica pa se trudi prepričati Marka za cepljenje proti tetanusu.
V novih epizodah bodo dramatični preobrati in zapleteni odnosi še naprej krojili življenja glavnih likov.
Znane obraze iz serije čakajo strašni zapleti in blazne spletke. Pridružili se jim bodo novi liki, ki bodo seriji dali nove razsežnosti, novo dinamiko in novo zgodbo. Mesto Zaglave bo doživelo nepričakovan preobrat in ubralo popolnoma novo smer razvoja. Turistično. Če si lahko zamislite kaj takega.

programme.title: Zlati sanjski moški: Avstralija
programme.desc:
Potovanje zapeljevanja se za Beara in njegova zlata dekleta, ki so mu še preostala, počasi izteka. Pred njimi je teden obiskov na domovih, ki prinese velika razkritja, težka vprašanja in ganljive trenutke. Ko Bear obišče svoje zadnje tri kandidatke, mora na koncu sprejeti najtežjo odločitev doslej in eno od njih poslati domov. Kateri dve bo vzel s seboj v finale?
61-letni vdovec Barry Bear Myrden je pripravljen na novo priložnost. Spozna 20 izjemnih žensk, ki v zrelih letih iščejo ljubezen.
Upravljalka dvigal, radijska voditeljica, medicinska sestra - nabor je res pester!
Na koktajl zabavi Sunny ukrade Beara, a jo prekine vsiljivka Kim. Bianca razkrije svoj strah pred zavrnitvijo, Jan pa prejme "vrtnico prvega vtisa".

programme.title: Ko cvetijo češnje
programme.desc:
V Atlantist pride Nazmijeva hči Naz in od Oyku zahteva, da ji preda očetovo podjetje. Oyku in Ayaz se glede tega spreta, saj Ayaz meni, da je Oyku odlična modna oblikovalka, ne pa tudi direktorica. To naj bi bil tudi razlog, da so jo zapustili vsi zaposleni, Oyku pa mu pove, da za tem gotovo stoji Onem. Mete gre na zmenek z Naz, Ilker in Emre pa odpreta nov lokal.
Oyku bi rada uspela kot modna oblikovalka, Ayaz pa je uspešen arhitekt. Sprva si gresta na živce, saj je Oyku všeč njegov sodelavec Mete, ki pa je všeč tudi njeni prijateljici Seymi. programme.title: Gorski zdravnik
programme.desc:
Potem ko se je šivilja Jasmin Martinu potožila nad svojo mamo Silke in mu zaupala, da namerava zapustiti mesto, pride do nepričakovanega zapleta.nnKo si Silke na stroju poškoduje roko, privoli, da bo poiskala zdravniško pomoč. Medtem ko Martin išče vzrok njenih nenavadnih simptomov, se Silkino stanje hitro začne slabšati. Lilli Martinu predlaga novo rešitev za kmetijo.
Serija predstavlja pustolovščine zdravnika in gorskega reševalca v idiličnih krajih avstrijskih Alp.
Martin Gruber živi svoje življenje skupaj z družino in se ukvarja s tistim, kar ljubi, in vse to v idilični pokrajini med gorami. Vsak primer, ki ga rešuje, pa je tesno povezan z družino in prijatelji. programme.title: Vaše zdravje, naša skrb
programme.desc:
Oddaja, namenjena izključno vašemu zdravju, v kateri se bomo posvetili zdravstvenim tegobam današnjega časa in vam ponudili rešitve za boljši jutri.
Hiter tempo življenja, slaba kvaliteta hrane, stres in genska zasnova – vse to vpliva na naše življenje bolj, kot bi si mislili. Po 40. letu starosti pa se začnejo počasi kazati posledice na našem telesu.
Slabo počutje, težave s prebavo, težave s sklepi, bolezni srca in ožilja, težave s sečili (ledvice, prostata), slaba koncentracija in slabši spomin; vse to in še mnogo več težav, s katerimi se borimo. Mi vam lahko pomagamo in svetujemo, kako lahko izboljšate svoj jutri.
Strokovnjaki iz slovenskega družinskega podjetja Biovis vam bomo v vsaki oddaji svetovali in vas informirali o različnih zdravstvenih težavah, s katerimi se spopadate, ter vam pomagali k boljšemu počutju.
Strokovnjaki, ki se z različnimi zdravstvenimi problemi ukvarjamo že skoraj 20 let, točno vemo, katero prehransko dopolnilo vam bo pri vaši težavi prišlo prav.

programme.title: Reka ljubezni
programme.desc:
Marija zameri Roku, ker hoče uničiti družinsko tradicijo. Sonja Eriku izroči denar in ga ustrahuje. Mojca ponudi Petri redno delo na stojnici.nnOpita Sonja pride v društvo in iz žepa ji pade pištola. Uroš in Jan kujeta maščevanje proti Andreju. Janez je hvaležen Mojci, zato jo zaposli. Jan brska po Andrejevi pisarni in najde sumljiva nakazila.
Reka ljubezni je nova, originalna slovenska serija, ki nas bo ponesla v idilični svet ob Krki.
Osrednja lika serije sta Irena Rot in Rok Slak, prikupna fotografinja iz mesta in simpatičen mizar z Dolenjske. Njuna pot do sreče pa bo vse prej kot lahka. V na prvi pogled idilični vasi se začnejo dogajati sumljive stvari, nekdo namreč podtika požare in seje strah v kosti vaščanom in gasilcem. Videti je, da nekateri komaj čakajo, da stegnejo svoje kremplje okrog vratu romantičnih parov, a prav ogenj zaneti prve iskre ljubezni. Da ne prehitevamo, Irena in Rok se morata najprej spoznati. Nejc Levstik, Jaka Šuligoj Lara Komar Tadej Pišek Marijana Brece

Pred njimi je teden obiskov na domovih, ki prinese velika razkritja, težka vprašanja in ganljive trenutke. Ko Bear obišče svoje zadnje tri kandidatke, mora na koncu sprejeti najtežjo odločitev doslej in eno od njih poslati domov. Kateri dve bo vzel s seboj v finale?

programme.title: Večerja za 5
programme.desc:
Večerja za 5 je priljubljena hrvaška kulinarična oddaja, ki prinaša različne recepte iz loncev domače kuhinje.
Tekmovalci pogosto pripravijo zanimive specialitete, s katerimi razveselijo brbončice sotekmovalcev. Večerja je sestavljena iz predjedi, glavne jedi in sladice. Na koncu večera gostje komentirajo pogostitev in vzdušje ter podajo oceno gostitelju.

programme.title: Po poti resnice
programme.desc:
Tugce njeni napadalci vržejo v morje in prepričani so, da je mrtva. A k sreči na Tugce naleti policija. Eren in Efe sta pretresena in vsi se bojijo za njeno življenje.nnLacin Yekti na poroki pripravi neprijetno presenečenje, ki vse šokira. Ilgaz skrbi za Mercan in Elif, Parlo pa doma preseneti gospod Canberk. Medtem sta Aylin in Osman še naprej v slabih odnosih.
Ilgaz je javni tožilec, ki je od svojega očeta prejel visoka etična načela glede poštenosti, časti in spoštovanja.
Ceylin je uspešna odvetnica, ki je morala zgodaj odrasti, ker so njenega očeta obsodili po krivem. Prav zaradi tega se je v svojem poklicu naučila ubirati tudi stranske poti.
Ko nekoč hoče od Ilgaza na nezakonit način pridobiti informacije, seveda dobi lekcijo o etiki in morali.
Ko pa Ilgazovega brata Cinarja obtožijo umora, je Ilgaz prvič prisiljen kršiti pravila. Obrne se prav na Ceylin, da bi zastopala njegovega brata. Ali Bilgin Kaan Urgancioglu Pinar Deniz Zeyno Eracar Ugur Aslan Arda Aranat Pinar Caglar G

programme.title: V dobrem in slabem
programme.desc:
Zrinka skupaj s Šarinićem dela na svojem romanu in ga skuša zapeljati, Ivana in Marina pa ju zalotita v kočljivem položaju. Veljko se sooči s Slavenom in kolegi, ki so zbrali denar za njegovo zdravljenje. Sanja konča v bolnišnici. Petro skrbi Zdravkovo izginotje, medtem ko Klaudija in Damjan preiskujeta Gabrijelo in prideta do Crnega.
Hrvaška serija V dobrem in slabem spremlja Veljka Srića, človeka, ki ga imajo vsi radi.
Veljko je uspešen podjetnik, ljubljeni mož in oče treh otrok. ki živi sanjsko življenje. Vendar se za to na videz popolno fasado skriva šokantna skrivnost - vzporedno življenje in druga družina v Sarajevu.
Veljko skrivnost skriva že 25 let, a ko izve, da sta mu ostala le še dva meseca življenja, se odloči soočiti z resnico in združiti obe družini pod eno streho. Njegovo priznanje bo sprožilo plaz čustev, konfliktov in nepredvidljivih dogodkov. When ESPN launched the SEC Network in 2014, it was only natural that Finebaum became its first on-air hire, bringing his radio show -- and those passionate followers -- with him. Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. The show airs weekday afternoons throughout the year on SEC Network.

programme.title: The Paul Finebaum Show
programme.desc: Veteran writer, reporter and radio personality Paul Finebaum built a legion of loyal sports fans as the "Voice of the SEC" during 20 years hosting his Birmingham, Ala.-based radio talk show. When ESPN launched the SEC Network in 2014, it was only natural that Finebaum became its first on-air hire, bringing his radio show -- and those passionate followers -- with him. Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. The show airs weekday afternoons throughout the year on SEC Network.

programme.title: Barron's Cove
programme.desc: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps.

programme.title: Fight or Flight
programme.desc: A mercenary takes on the job of tracking a high-value asset known only as "The Ghost" on an international flight. Realizing the plane is filled with assassins assigned to kill them both, the pair must work together in a fight for their lives.

programme.title: Undisputed
programme.desc: An undefeated world-champion prizefighter, who is convicted of rape and sent to prison, must confront and fight the reigning prison boxing champion.

programme.title: Undisputed II: Last Man Standing
programme.desc: Imprisoned in Russia, a man (Michael Jai White) relies on his street-fighting skills while fighting boxers in the ring.

programme.title: Undisputed III: Redemption
programme.desc: Uri Boyka is an inmate trapped in the toughest prison in the world. He is ready to make his comeback in a lethal boxing competition for a shot at freedom.

programme.title: Jackass: The Movie
programme.desc: In this comedic documentary, Johnny Knoxville heads a crew of stuntmen, skateboarders and all-around lunatics as they prank, embarrass and torture each other in the name of fun. The antics range from childlike -- the boys don panda suits for a romp through Tokyo -- to grotesque and life-threatening. A golf cart demolition derby turns downright dangerous. Live gators nearly chomp maniac Steve-O. Filmmaker Spike Jonze and Knoxville, in heavy makeup, test the public's patience for the elderly.

programme.title: Jenny's Wedding
programme.desc: When Jenny (Katherine Heigl) decides to marry a woman (Alexis Bledel), her conventional family must accept who she is or risk losing her forever.

programme.title: Drop Zone
programme.desc: A daring prison break from an airliner at 30,000 feet leaves U.S. Marshal Pete Nessip (Wesley Snipes) mourning a brother and gunning for revenge. After being ordered to turn in his badge, he seeks out Jessie Crossman (Yancy Butler), a noted skydiver, and offers to sponsor her crew for the annual Independence Day parachuting show in Washington, D.C., if she trains him. Meanwhile, the mastermind behind the mid-air jailbreak (Gary Busey) is planning a daring computer theft on Independence Day.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Tom Cruise and Cameron Crowe reunite after "Jerry Maguire" for "Vanilla Sky," the story of a young New York City publishing magnate who finds himself on an unexpected roller-coaster ride of romance, comedy, suspicion, love, sex and dreams in a mind-bending search for his soul.

programme.title: Chuck
programme.desc: He was the pride of Bayonne, N.J., a man who went 15 rounds in the ring with Muhammad Ali. But before all of that, Chuck Wepner was a liquor salesman and father with a modest prizefighting career whose life changed overnight when, in 1975, he was chosen to take on Ali in a highly publicized title match. It's the beginning of a wild ride through the exhilarating highs and humbling lows of sudden fame, but what happens when your 15 minutes in the spotlight are up?

programme.title: Villain
programme.desc: A razor-wielding London thug (Richard Burton) robs a payroll with his gang; his pimp boyfriend (Ian McShane) has the alibi.

programme.title: Defiance
programme.desc: In 1941, Nazi soldiers are slaughtering Eastern European Jews by the thousands. Three brothers, Tuvia (Daniel Craig), Zus (Liev Schreiber) and Asael (Jamie Bell), manage to escape and take refuge in the forest where they played in childhood. Seeking a way to avenge the deaths of their loved ones, the brothers turn their daily struggle for survival into a battle against the Nazis. As news of their exploits spreads, others join the fray, willing to risk their lives for even brief freedom.

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: When hotheaded Superboy (Michael Rapaport) accidentally gets involved in an ugly racially-motivated incident, his uncle Ray Donlan (Harvey Keitel), a corrupt New York City cop, attempts to sweep it under the rug by helping fake his nephew's death. The bungled cover-up leads to investigations by idealistic Internal Affairs officer Moe Tilden (Robert De Niro) and Freddy Heflin (Sylvester Stallone), sheriff of the suburban New Jersey town where Donlan and his fellow crooked policemen live.

programme.title: Queenpins
programme.desc: A frustrated suburban housewife and her best friend hatch an illegal coupon-club scheme that scams millions from corporations and delivers deals to legions of fellow coupon clippers. Hot on their trail is an unlikely duo -- a hapless loss-prevention officer and a determined U.S. postal inspector -- both looking to end their criminal enterprise.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: Brad Pitt stars as Jerry Welbach, a reluctant bagman, who has been given two ultimatums: The first is from his mob boss to travel to Mexico and retrieve a priceless antique pistol, known as "the Mexican"... or suffer the consequences. The second is from his girlfriend Samantha (Julia Roberts) to end his association with the mob. Jerry figures alive and in trouble with Samantha is better than the more permanent alternative, so he heads south of the border.

programme.title: Guns Up
programme.desc: After a job goes horribly wrong, a man who moonlights as a mob henchman has one night to get his family out of the city while keeping his dark secret hidden.

programme.title: The Grifters
programme.desc: Hard-as-nails Lily Dillon (Anjelica Huston) works as a swindler for dangerous bookie Bobo (Pat Hingle), probably the only man she fears. Arriving in Los Angeles on business, Lily looks up her son, Roy (John Cusack), a small-time con artist content with paltry sleight-of-hand cheats. Roy's girlfriend, Myra (Annette Bening), looks like an All-American type but is a grifter looking to pull off another big-time con. The convergence of the three hustlers inevitably means trouble for all of them.

programme.title: Sexorcist
programme.desc: Something possesses a beautiful women to act wild and crazy.

programme.title: Queenpins
programme.desc: A frustrated suburban housewife and her best friend hatch an illegal coupon-club scheme that scams millions from corporations and delivers deals to legions of fellow coupon clippers. Hot on their trail is an unlikely duo -- a hapless loss-prevention officer and a determined U.S. postal inspector -- both looking to end their criminal enterprise.

programme.title: Sleeping Dogs
programme.desc: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past.

programme.title: Equilibrium
programme.desc: In a futuristic world, a regime has eliminated war by suppressing emotions: books, art and music are strictly forbidden and feeling is a crime punishable by death. Clerick John Preston (Christian Bale) is a top-ranking government agent responsible for destroying those who resist these rules. When he misses a dose of Prozium, a mind-altering drug that hinders emotion, Preston, who has been trained to enforce strict laws of the new regime, suddenly becomes the one capable of overthrowing it.

programme.title: Love and Monsters
programme.desc: Seven years after the Monsterpocalypse, Joel Dawson, along with the rest of humanity, has been living underground ever since giant creatures took control of the land. After reconnecting over the radio with his high school girlfriend, Aimee, who is now 80 miles away at a coastal colony, Joel begins to fall for her again. As Joel realizes that there's nothing left for him underground, he decides to venture out to Aimee, despite all the dangerous monsters that stand in his way.

programme.title: The Comeback Trail
programme.desc: Indebted to a mobster, a desperate producer tries to "accidentally" kill an aging movie star for an insurance scam. However, he soon begins to realize that the film they're shooting is a masterpiece in the making.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody...

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: Sydney (Neve Campbell) and tabloid reporter Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) survived the events of the first Scream, but their nightmare isn't over. When two college students are murdered at a sneak preview of Stab, a movie based on the events from the first film, it's clear a copycat killer is on the loose. Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead.

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: In the final installment to this trilogy, a murdering spree begins to happen again; this time targeted toward the original Woodsboro survivors and those associated with the movie-inside a-movie, Stab 3. Sydney (Neve Campbell) must face the demons of her past to stop the killer(s).

programme.title: Scream 4
programme.desc: It has been many years since the Ghostface Killer cut a deadly path through the town of Woodsboro. In order to get over the trauma of those horrific events, Sidney Prescott (Neve Campbell) has written a self-help book. She returns to Woodsboro for her book tour, and reconnects with old friends Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) and Sheriff Dewey (David Arquette). However, Sidney's arrival also sparks the return of Ghostface, putting Sidney and everyone she loves in danger.

programme.title: Shell
programme.desc: Desperate to reclaim her career, once-beloved actress Samantha Lake gets drawn into the glamorous world of wellness mogul Zoe Shannon, only to uncover a monstrous truth beneath the seemingly flawless surface.

programme.title: Vicious
programme.desc: Polly receives a mysterious box that comes with instructions to place three things inside: something you need, something you hate, and something you love. What begins as a strange ritual quickly unravels into a waking nightmare as she becomes trapped in a terrifying world where reality bends and memory betrays. As time slips away, she must confront the darkness not just around her, but within her, before it consumes everything and everyone she's ever known.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody...

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: Sydney (Neve Campbell) and tabloid reporter Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) survived the events of the first Scream, but their nightmare isn't over. When two college students are murdered at a sneak preview of Stab, a movie based on the events from the first film, it's clear a copycat killer is on the loose. Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead.

programme.title: Extract
programme.desc: The owner of a factory that produces flavor extracts, Joel Reynold (Jason Bateman) seems to have it all, but really doesn't. What's missing is sexual attention from his wife, Suzie (Kristen Wiig). Joel hatches a convoluted plan to get Suzie to cheat on him, thereby clearing the way for Joel to have an affair with Cindy (Mila Kunis), an employee. But what Joel doesn't know is that Cindy is a sociopathic con artist, and a freak workplace accident clears the way for her to ruin Joel forever.

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
programme.desc: After surviving a car accident, Michelle (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) wakes up to find herself in an underground bunker with two men. Howard (John Goodman) tells her that a massive chemical attack has rendered the air unbreathable, and their only hope of survival is to remain inside. Despite the comforts of home, Howard's controlling and menacing nature makes Michelle want to escape. After taking matters into her own hands, the young woman finally discovers the truth about the outside world.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Based on the popular Tom Clancy novel, this suspenseful movie tracks Soviet submarine captain Marko Ramius (Sean Connery) as he abandons his orders and heads for the east coast of the United States. Equipped with innovative stealth technology, Ramius' submarine, "Red October," is virtually invisible. However, when an American sub briefly detects the Russians' presence, CIA agent Jack Ryan (Alec Baldwin) sets out to determine Ramius' motives, fearing he may launch an attack on the U.S.

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: Based on Tom Clancy's novel, this espionage thriller tracks a sinister plot to draw the United States and Russia into World War III. When the Russian president (Ciarán Hinds) suddenly dies, world tension escalates. Coupled with missing nuclear scientists and the threat of a nuclear detonation on United States soil, young CIA analyst Jack Ryan (Ben Affleck) must uncover who is behind the conspiracy.

programme.title: Danger Close
programme.desc: Australian and New Zealand soldiers face overwhelming odds as they fight for their lives during the Battle of Long Tan in Vietnam.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: The Top Gun Naval Fighter Weapons School is where the best of the best train to refine their elite flying skills. When hotshot fighter pilot Maverick (Tom Cruise) is sent to the school, his reckless attitude and cocky demeanor put him at odds with the other pilots, especially the cool and collected Iceman (Val Kilmer). But Maverick isn't only competing to be the top fighter pilot, he's also fighting for the attention of his beautiful flight instructor, Charlotte Blackwood (Kelly McGillis).

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: After more than 30 years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators, Pete "Maverick" Mitchell is where he belongs, pushing the envelope as a courageous test pilot and dodging the advancement in rank that would ground him. Training a detachment of graduates for a special assignment, Maverick must confront the ghosts of his past and his deepest fears, culminating in a mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice from those who choose to fly it.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Based on the popular Tom Clancy novel, this suspenseful movie tracks Soviet submarine captain Marko Ramius (Sean Connery) as he abandons his orders and heads for the east coast of the United States. Equipped with innovative stealth technology, Ramius' submarine, "Red October," is virtually invisible. However, when an American sub briefly detects the Russians' presence, CIA agent Jack Ryan (Alec Baldwin) sets out to determine Ramius' motives, fearing he may launch an attack on the U.S.

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: Based on Tom Clancy's novel, this espionage thriller tracks a sinister plot to draw the United States and Russia into World War III. When the Russian president (Ciarán Hinds) suddenly dies, world tension escalates. Coupled with missing nuclear scientists and the threat of a nuclear detonation on United States soil, young CIA analyst Jack Ryan (Ben Affleck) must uncover who is behind the conspiracy.

programme.title: Gone Baby Gone
programme.desc: Along with his girlfriend (Michelle Monaghan), a private detective (Casey Affleck) takes on the difficult task of searching for a kidnapped girl in Boston. During his investigation, he must deal with the girl's aunt, a disapproving lawman (Morgan Freeman) and a drug dealer.

programme.title: If You Lust Me
programme.desc: A young woman puts the age-old adage of love at first sight to the test when a stranger professes his undying devotion. But is he sincere or is it just another con by some hustler trying to get her in bed? She decides to give him a test... of sorts..

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: The mysterious Catherine Tramell, a beautiful crime novelist, becomes a suspect when she is linked to the brutal death of a rock star. Investigated by homicide detective Nick Curran, Catherine seduces him into an intense relationship. Meanwhile, the murder case becomes increasingly complicated when more seemingly connected deaths occur and Nick's psychologist and lover, Beth Garner, appears to be another suspect.

programme.title: The Fitzgerald Family Christmas
programme.desc: Rifts emerge among family members when their long-estranged patriarch decides to come home for the holidays.

programme.title: The Soloist
programme.desc: Los Angeles columnist Steve Lopez (Robert Downey Jr.) has reached an impasse in his life. His marriage is on the rocks, and he's disillusioned with his job. Then, while wandering through L.A.'s Skid Row, he spots a homeless man (Jamie Foxx) playing a two-stringed violin with a virtuoso's skill. Lopez initially thinks of the man, named Nathaniel Ayers, as just a story idea. But as he begins to unravel the mystery of Ayers' strange fate, Lopez realizes that a change is happening within himself.

programme.title: The Martian
programme.desc: When astronauts blast off from the planet Mars, they leave behind Mark Watney, presumed dead after a fierce storm. With only a meager amount of supplies, the stranded visitor must utilize his wits and spirit to find a way to survive on the hostile planet. Meanwhile, back on Earth, members of NASA and a team of international scientists work tirelessly to bring him home, while his crew mates hatch their own plan for a daring rescue mission.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: Thrilled by his experience with the Avengers, young Peter Parker returns home to live with his Aunt May. Under the watchful eye of mentor Tony Stark, Parker starts to embrace his newfound identity as Spider-Man. He also tries to return to his normal daily routine -- distracted by thoughts of proving himself to be more than just a friendly neighborhood superhero. Peter must soon put his powers to the test when the evil Vulture emerges to threaten everything that he holds dear.

programme.title: Twisted
programme.desc: Recently promoted and transferred to the homicide division, Inspector Jessica Shepard (Ashley Judd) feels pressure to prove herself -- and what better way than by solving San Francisco's latest murder? However, as Shepard and her partner, Mike Delmarco (Andy Garcia), soon discover, the victim shared a romantic connection to her. As more of Shepard's ex-lovers turn up dead, her mind starts to become unstable, and she begins to wonder if she could be the very killer she's trying to track down.

programme.title: Rocketman
programme.desc: Young Reginald Dwight changes his name to Elton John and collaborates with singer-songwriter Bernie Taupin to become one of the most iconic figures in pop history. Set to his most beloved songs, it's the epic musical story of Elton John, his breakthrough years in the 1970s and his fantastical transformation from shy piano prodigy to international superstar.

programme.title: Pixels
programme.desc: When aliens intercept video feeds of classic arcade games and misinterpret them as a declaration of war, they attack Earth, using the games as models. Knowing that he must employ a similar strategy, President Will Cooper (Kevin James) recruits his childhood pal, former video-game champ and home-theater installer Sam Brenner (Adam Sandler), to lead a team of old-school arcade players and a military specialist (Michelle Monaghan) in an all-out battle to save the planet.

programme.title: 40 Days and 40 Nights
programme.desc: Matt Sullivan's (Josh Hartnett) last big relationship ended in disaster and ever since his heart's been aching and his commitment's been lacking. Then came Lent, that time of year when everybody gives something up. That's when Matt decides to go where no man's gone before and make a vow: No sex. Whatsoever. For 40 straight days. At first he has everything under control. That is until the woman of his dreams, Erica (Shannyn Sossamon), walks into his life.

programme.title: Adore
programme.desc: Two lifelong best friends (Robin Wright, Naomi Watts) each begin a steamy affair with the other's son, but trouble begins to brew when one of the two young men desires a lover his own age.

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: A young man (Matthew McConaughey) continues to live at the home of parents who, in desperation to push him out of the nest once and for all, hatch a plan. They hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to assume the mantle of responsibility and get his own place.

programme.title: Heist 88
programme.desc: A criminal mastermind decides to pull one last job before going to prison and recruits a group of young bank employees to steal millions in a daring and brazen assault on the U.S. banking system.

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa 0.5
programme.desc: Irving Zisman takes his young and impressionable grandson on a cross-country trip in which they encounter male strippers, biker-bar patrons and other unsuspecting citizens.

programme.title: Camp X-Ray
programme.desc: A female guard (Kristen Stewart) at Guantanamo Bay forms an unlikely friendship with one of the facility's longtime detainees.

programme.title: Certain Women
programme.desc: Three strong-willed women (Kristen Stewart, Laura Dern, Michelle Williams) strive to forge their own paths amidst the wide-open plains of the American Northwest: a lawyer who finds herself contending with both office sexism and a hostage situation; a wife and mother whose determination to build her dream home puts her at odds with the men in her life; and a young law student who forms an ambiguous bond with a lonely ranch hand.

programme.title: India Sweets and Spices
programme.desc: After returning from college, young Alia upends her family's well-ordered life with her brash new independence. When secrets about her parents come to light during a dinner party, it soon pushes her to a daring and ultimately hilarious confrontation.

programme.title: Parallel
programme.desc: Following the journey of Vanessa, a grief-stricken woman who mysteriously finds herself navigating between parallel spaces.

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: To the students at Harrington High, the principal and her posse of teachers have always been a little odd, but lately they've been behaving positively alien. Controlled by otherworldly parasites, the faculty try to infect students one by one. Cheerleader Delilah (Jordana Brewster), football player Stan (Shawn Hatosy), drug dealer Zeke (Josh Hartnett) and new girl Marybeth (Laura Harris) team up with some of their other classmates to fight back against the invaders.

programme.title: Love and Monsters
programme.desc: Seven years after the Monsterpocalypse, Joel Dawson, along with the rest of humanity, has been living underground ever since giant creatures took control of the land. After reconnecting over the radio with his high school girlfriend, Aimee, who is now 80 miles away at a coastal colony, Joel begins to fall for her again. As Joel realizes that there's nothing left for him underground, he decides to venture out to Aimee, despite all the dangerous monsters that stand in his way.

programme.title: Band Aid
programme.desc: Anna and Ben can't stop fighting. Advised by their therapist to try and work through their grief unconventionally, they are reminded of their shared love of music. In a last-ditch effort to save their marriage, they decide to turn all of their fights into songs, and with the help of their neighbor, Dave, they start a band.

programme.title: Parallel
programme.desc: Following the journey of Vanessa, a grief-stricken woman who mysteriously finds herself navigating between parallel spaces.

programme.title: 16 Shots
programme.desc: A Chicago police officer is charged with murder after the shooting of Laquan McDonald.

Controlled by otherworldly parasites, the faculty try to infect students one by one. Cheerleader Delilah (Jordana Brewster), football player Stan (Shawn Hatosy), drug dealer Zeke (Josh Hartnett) and new girl Marybeth (Laura Harris) team up with some of their other classmates to fight back against the invaders.

As Joel realizes that there's nothing left for him underground, he decides to venture out to Aimee, despite all the dangerous monsters that stand in his way.

programme.title: Boogie Woogie
programme.desc: A tycoon's crafty wife plays rival bidders against each other as a shady art dealer tries to obtain a valuable painting.

programme.title: India Sweets and Spices
programme.desc: After returning from college, young Alia upends her family's well-ordered life with her brash new independence. When secrets about her parents come to light during a dinner party, it soon pushes her to a daring and ultimately hilarious confrontation.
